THIS JUDGMENT WAS REACHED BY STIPULATION. THE TOTAL RENT OWED FOR 57 SYCAMORE STREET, SAN FRANCISCO IS $,310.41. OF THUS AMOUNT DEFENDANT JENNIFER MORIN SHALL PAY $425.00. AND TRIAN LILES SHALL PAY $885,41. THIS AMOUNT SHALL BE PAID BY 6-15-95 AND WILL COVER RENT THROUGH 6-30-95. THERE AFTER MONTHLY RENT WILL BE $850.00 A MONTH. THERE WILL BE NO MORE THAN THREE PEOPLE OCCUPYING THESE PREMISES. ON 6-15-95, PLAINTIFF RAMON MASCARINAS SHALL GIVE DEFENDANT A RECEIPT SHOWING THAT PLAINTIFF HAS PAID FOR PEST CONTROL. THE PEST CONTROL WILL HAVE A GUARANTEE OF 3 MONTHS. WITHIN 10 DAYS, 6-2-95, PLAINTIFF WILL REPAIR THE FRONT GATE AT 57 SYCAMORE STREET, THE BACK LOCK ON THE BATHROOM WINDOW AND THE BASEROOM DOOR. THE HEATING SYSTEM WILL ALSO BE REPAIRED BY 6-30-95. BY 5-25-95 PLAINTIFF MASCARINAS WILL NOTIFY DEFENDANTS LILES AND MORIN ABOUT THE LENGTH OF WORK ON THEIR ROOF, WHEN IT WILL BEGIN AND WHEN IT WILL END. THE INTERIOR HALLWAY OF OF THE UNIT AND THE BACK STAIRS WILL BE REPAIRED,
TRIAL OFF CALENDAR
